$comment: Machine-readable pins for ADR-0001. Normative: an implementation or gate that disagrees with this file is wrong. See mcp/ADR-0001-runtime-and-dependency.md.

runtime.framing: newline-delimited JSON, trailing \r tolerated, no Content-Length

protocol.negotiation: echo the client's requested protocolVersion verbatim when it is in supportedVersions; otherwise reply with advertise
protocol.domainFailureShape: successful tools/call result with isError: true, never a JSON-RPC error

goldenQueryGate.requirement: MUST drive the server through the real SDK client (Client + StdioClientTransport) — this is what makes the zero-dependency choice safe
goldenQueryGate.sdkUsage: test-time only, via npx or a scratch tree; never a shipped dependency, never committed to the repo

runnerUp.condition: only if HTTP/streamable transport is un-deferred, or a required capability lands that must be hand-implemented (sampling, elicitation, progress, tasks)
runnerUp.shape: scoped mcp/package.json; repo root stays manifest-free
runnerUp.requiresLawAmendment: scoped carve-out to CONTRIBUTING.md:69 and scripts/validate.mjs:12-14

use: setRequestHandler with SDK-exported request schemas from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js
api.reason: registerTool inputSchema is ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema, and AnySchema = z3.ZodTypeAny | z4.$ZodType (dist/esm/server/zod-compat.d.ts:3) — both Zod. The high-level API makes 'one runtime dep' false. The low-level Server takes SDK-exported schemas, so your source never imports zod and hand-written JSON Schema passes through unmodified.

doNotUse.reason: 17 minors stale; lacks registerResource entirely, and its four resource() overloads are @deprecated on 1.29.0. Pin against what ships, not what is installed.

smoke.preExistingFailure: .claude/skills/loop-build/templates/v1-conductor.workflow.js — declares a planner node but --planner fable never routed to claude-fable-5
smoke.note: pre-existing on develop before any mcp/ work; not caused by and not in scope for D1

gateBaseline.mcpDirIsGateNeutral: validate.mjs scopes its walk to .claude/skills (line 24) and node --checks in os.tmpdir() (line 287); smoke.mjs walks ROOT but skips node_modules by name (line 25) and collects only *.workflow.js
